szoveg_eredeti:
For several months, UBS chief executive Sergio Ermotti has been warning anyone who will listen that global markets have become complacent.

But with the artificial intelligence trade now looking decidedly wobbly, and Wall Street still licking its wounds from last week’s dramatic sell-off, Ermotti certainly isn’t in I-told-you-so mode.
